review_type: Preliminary source-candidate comparison to the exact bound Skyway reference; not formal QA11 or owner review

reference.label: IMAGE_2
reference.acceptance_scope: Own synthetic currentD original-controller scene with inherited R70 background preview and R71 flat-hand registration. No scene pixels in hand output; background crop/nativequality and all creative acceptance remain open.

candidate_view: Full unmodified generated image displayed and directly inspected. Reference had been directly inspected; exact source bytes rechecked. No candidate-in-game capture exists yet.

axes.contour: Irregular softly brushed edge replaces uniform purple/black stroke. Five digits: left thumb, three curled fingers and uniquely lowest down index. A bright gold rim remains a native-size review concern.
axes.material: Authored-looking ivory brush texture and rounded soft shading relate better to painted pearl/gold/glass neighbors than the original flat fill; source-only judgment.
axes.palette: Warm ivory-gold highlights and lavender reflected shadows match the reference pearl rails and lavender/gold destination.
axes.light: Broad warm upper-left/front highlight with cool lower-right creases broadly follows the reference; no measured in-context lighting acceptance.
axes.perspective: Same downward-pointing schematic/back-of-hand reading. Isolated instructional card has no scene-camera projection validation yet.
axes.scale: High-resolution source is available; actual49px-scale readability, fingertip registration and device filter quality are pending. Native1254square output needs runtime-size derivative.
axes.contact: Instructional floating cue, no physical contact expected. Fingertip-to-waypoint alignment remains pending in actual controller.
axes.occlusion: Transparent outer field; candidate has faint low-alpha speckles. Neighbor/Roshan/path overlap must be tested in context. No occlusion acceptance.
axes.readability: Down-index gesture and five-digit topology read at full source size. Small-size contour/glow/contrast remains untested.
axes.action_state: One static gesture candidate. Existing bob/action/return states and all callers/fallback retirement remain untested with these pixels.

second_take: Not used; avoid another generation for novelty. One remaining take within existing cap only if a documented targeted failure requires it.
